strategies.title: Advanced Chunking & Reranker Pipeline
strategies.description: Maximize retrieval precision and answer groundedness with hierarchical chunking and cross-encoder reranking.

hierarchical.title: Parent-Child (Hierarchical)
hierarchical.description: Store small chunks for precise vector matching while providing parent text to the LLM to preserve context.

semantic.description: Automatically split documents when cosine similarity between consecutive sentences drops below the threshold.

markdown_ast.description: Preserve data tables (Data Tables) and H1, H2, H3 heading structure as intact blocks.

recursive.description: Fixed segmentation by character length and overlap window (character window overlap).

strategies.params_description: Set token length limits and inspect the chunk structure live
strategies.parent_chunk_hint: Large text blocks go into the model's prompt to ensure answers carry full context.
strategies.child_chunk_hint: Short sizes optimize vector matching in multidimensional space (Cosine Distance).
strategies.semantic_threshold_hint: Auto-split threshold: when similarity between two consecutive sentences falls below this threshold, a new segment starts.
strategies.ast_hint: Preserve the table-of-contents heading structure and data table blocks (Tables) without splitting financial rows or columns.
strategies.recursive_hint: Split text into ~512-character segments with a 64-character overlap to maintain sentence-level semantics.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy (Zero Retention)
privacy.zdr_description: Requires cloud providers (OpenAI, Google) to commit under the Enterprise agreement: no conversation logs stored on their servers and no internal data used for model training.
privacy.encryption_description: All conversation records and metadata are encrypted with internal HSM keys before being written to the platform's PostgreSQL database.
